about_the_game:
Welcome to Red Passport: Ticket to Russia — an adventure game that takes you to the heart of Russia! Begin your journey in a cozy apartment, where the first puzzles set the stage for your epic quest. Pack your bags, head to the airport, and board a plane to a new city. But that’s just the start — an unforgettable train ride across Russia’s vast landscapes awaits, leading you to Vladivostok.

What to expect:

  • Engaging Story: Unravel mysteries and stories hidden at every step of your journey.

  • Diverse Locations: From an atmospheric city apartment to a bustling airport, a plane, and an iconic train.

  • Puzzles and Challenges: Use your wits to overcome obstacles and progress.

  • Cultural Immersion: Experience Russia’s essence through detailed landscapes, sounds, and unique elements.

Red Passport: Ticket to Russia is a journey full of discoveries, where every step brings you closer to your destination. Can you reach Vladivostok and uncover all its secrets?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-9100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-10100
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060

short_description: Embark on a thrilling journey across Russia! From a cozy apartment to the airport, fly to a new city, and ride a train to Vladivostok. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover secrets along the way!
supported_languages:
English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Russian*, Japanese
*languages with full audio support
